''See also: [[Akura Harmony Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-11-dreadgod|[[Akura clan|Akura]] Harmony was a member of the [[Akura clan]], a family known for utilizing [[shadow madra]] and naming its members after virtues. A highly disciplined individual, Harmony dedicated himself to constant training and [[cycling]] to ensure he never wasted time or breath. He was a competitive person whose personality often clashed with his family; for instance, he once publicly denounced [[Akura Charity]] and ended their engagement after being defeated by her in a swordsmanship match. In combat, Harmony was a formidable [[Shadow|shadow]] artist who utilized the [[Shadow’s Edge]] [[technique]], a striker ability with [[sword]] and [[Shadow|shadow]] [[aspects]] that could slice through both physical and spiritual matter. He also possessed the ability to manifest violet crystal [[bloodline armor]], which featured a dark disc hovering behind his head. During his time in the [[pocket world]] of [[Ghostwater]], he acted as a recipient of the location's treasures, specifically returning the [[Eye of the Deep]] to a jeweled tree. Harmony eventually met his end during a conflict in [[Ghostwater]], with some suggesting he had lost a game he started with every advantage. His death left a significant impact on his relatives, including [[Charity]] and [[Mercy]].}}

== Appearance ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-11-dreadgod|[[Akura clan|Akura]] Harmony possesses purple eyes and a black disc [[Goldsign]]. He is dressed in black-and-white [[sacred artist's robe|sacred artist's robes]] and wears armor made of violet crystal.}}

== Relationships ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-11-dreadgod|[[Akura clan|Akura]] Harmony was the fiancé of [[Mercy]] and an engagement partner to [[Akura Charity]]. He served as a member of [[Charity]]'s team, having been chosen by her to be the second person on the primary squad. Additionally, he is the grand-nephew of [[Akura Charity]] and fought [[Lindon]], leaving his [[spirit]] associated with a [[binding]] inside [[Lindon's axe]].}}

== Abilities ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-11-dreadgod|A [[Truegold]] at the peak of his stage, Harmony utilizes [[shadow madra]] and breathes darkness. His combat repertoire includes the use of an axe and the [[Shadow]]'s Edge [[technique]], and he has access to [[Ghostwater]] through his [[Eye of the Deep]].}}

{{spoiler|book=cradle-05-ghostwater|As a [[Truegold]] at the peak of his stage, [[Akura clan|Akura]] Harmony breathes darkness and possesses a spark of [[soulfire]] within his [[soulspace]].<ref name="cradle-05-ghostwater-c4">''Ghostwater'', chapter 4</ref> Formerly [[Mercy]]'s fiancé, he is a member of the [[Akura clan]] and serves as an [[Akura clan|Akura]] representative.<ref name="cradle-05-ghostwater-c7">''Ghostwater'', chapter 7</ref><ref name="cradle-05-ghostwater-c15">''Ghostwater'', chapter 15</ref><ref name="cradle-05-ghostwater-c16">''Ghostwater'', chapter 16</ref> He is characterized by purple eyes, a black disc [[Goldsign]], and the wearing of black-and-white [[sacred artist's robe|sacred artist's robes]].<ref name="cradle-05-ghostwater-c15" /> After raising a [[dead sapphire]], he utilized an [[Eye of the Deep]] to access [[Ghostwater]] and shoved the [[Eye]] inside a cage.<ref name="cradle-05-ghostwater-c15" /><ref name="cradle-05-ghostwater-c16" /> While standing in front of a [[stone]] birdbath, he wielded [[shadow madra]] and wore armor made of violet crystal.<ref name="cradle-05-ghostwater-c16" /><ref name="cradle-05-ghostwater-c18">''Ghostwater'', chapter 18</ref> A fight with Harmony left [[Lindon's body]] and [[spirit]] completely exhausted.<ref name="cradle-05-ghostwater-c19">''Ghostwater'', chapter 19</ref>}}

=== {{spoiler|book=cradle-06-underlord|Ghostwater Mission}} ===
{{spoiler|book=cradle-06-underlord|The [[Akura clan|Akura family]] sent Harmony to [[Ghostwater]].<ref name="cradle-06-underlord-c4">''Underlord'', chapter 4</ref> While [[Lindon]] desired to explain the exact circumstances of her arrival, Harmony demonstrated her power by killing [[Renfei]] with a single strike.<ref name="cradle-06-underlord-c4" /><ref name="cradle-06-underlord-c5">''Underlord'', chapter 5</ref> An axe is the weapon used by this individual, who is the grand-nephew of [[Akura Charity]].<ref name="cradle-06-underlord-c11">''Underlord'', chapter 11</ref><ref name="cradle-06-underlord-c13">''Underlord'', chapter 13</ref> As an engagement partner of [[Akura Charity]], Harmony was selected to serve as the second member on the primary team before ultimately being killed.<ref name="cradle-06-underlord-c13" />}}

=== {{spoiler|book=cradle-06-underlord|Spirit in the Axe}} ===
{{spoiler|book=cradle-06-underlord|[[Akura clan|Akura]] Harmony's [[spirit]] is linked to a [[binding]] located within [[Lindon's axe]].<ref name="cradle-06-underlord-c20">''Underlord'', chapter 20</ref> Because of the [[Akura clan]], [[Lindon]] feels hesitant to relinquish the weapon containing her [[spirit]].<ref name="cradle-06-underlord-c21">''Underlord'', chapter 21</ref> Additionally, Harmony had been chosen by [[Charity]] to be a member of her team.<ref name="cradle-06-underlord-c21" />}}

</ul></div>

{{spoiler|book=cradle-08-wintersteel|[[Akura clan|Akura]] Harmony is a character that [[Lindon]] had conceived of in his mind but had not yet assigned a name to.<ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c12">''Wintersteel'', chapter 12</ref> In combat, she utilizes the [[Shadow]]'s Edge [[technique]].<ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c5">''Wintersteel'', chapter 5</ref> The [[Akura clan]] eventually held [[Lindon]] accountable regarding Harmony.<ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c14">''Wintersteel'', chapter 14</ref>}}
